construction_notes.text: City of San Jose permit PRE26-301 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2026), status Complete: "SB 330 Preliminary Application for the construction of a 288-unit for-rent workforce housing project for employees of San Jose Unified School District."

District page lists the Hillsdale site as 760 Hillsdale Avenue and 705-745 Capital Expressway and estimates 26 to 41 months until construction starts; it states no property purchase decision has been made.

San José Spotlight (July 2026) reports the district is also considering buying 337 of the 643 condos at Silvery Towers, 188 West St. James St., as an alternative, funded from the $1.15 billion Measure R bond; the district has signed only exploratory consultant contracts.
